noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

minUniqueCount.description: required minimum unique field values for each PII field in any aggregated row.

maxContributionPercent.description:
allowed maximum contribution for any  PII field value as percent of total in any aggregated row. e.g 30, if one key
can not have value more than 30% of total value from selected rows.

title:
The @PIIAggregation annotation is used conditionally alow aggregated results when the type has fields marked with @PII.
Typically users will not be allowed to retrieve raw data that reveals @PII fields. but they will be allowed to get
aggregated data when the conditions provided are satisfied.
name: Ann.PiiAggregation
